lines.text: The next morning...
As usual, the female staff member walks through the alleyway toward the Mystery Box booth.
As she approaches the booth, she comes to a stop.
A small witch doll sits alone on the bench across from the booth.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: No... it can't be.
The female staff member slowly walks over to the bench.
She stops dead in front of the doll, staring down at its missing ear.
*Swoosh, swoosh*
She looks around frantically, but there's no one else around.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: B-but we definitely threw it out yesterday...

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: H-how did it...
She picks up the witch doll with trembling hands and sprints to the booth.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: B-boss!!

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Whoa, why are you sprinting here this early in the morning?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Y-you have to see this...!
The female staff member holds up the witch doll.

lines.speaker: malestaff_01
lines.text: ... Huh? Isn't this the doll we threw out yesterday?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I-it is...!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: It's missing an ear, exactly the way I cut it off!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I-it's the same doll. It came back again...!

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Give me that.
The man in the jacket snatches the doll away and examines its severed left ear.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: ... Is this really the same cut you made?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Y-yes! It's the same! You saw it yesterday, too!

lines.speaker: malestaff_01
lines.text: ... I'm sure I threw it away in a trash can far from here, too.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Was there anyone near you when you threw it out?

lines.speaker: malestaff_01
lines.text: No, there was no one.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: ... Looks like we're being watched.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: B-being watched?

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Otherwise, there's no way to explain why the doll keeps coming back.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Th-then...

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: It must be those people from Little Witch Trick!

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: They're the only ones who have multiple witch dolls like this...!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: They even came by our booth to ask about the doll and the forum posts.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Th-they must've found out that we were the ones who made the posts...!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I-it has to be them... They're scaring us on purpose because they know what we've done...!!

lines.speaker: malestaff_01
lines.text: J-just calm down first.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: H-how am I supposed to calm down?!

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: ... Then let's go there ourselves and find out.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: We need to talk.
The three Mystery Box staff members approach us.
*Plop*
The man in the jacket drops the witch doll with the missing ear in front of us.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Is this your doing?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: D-don't act like you don't know anything!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Th-this doll keeps showing up at our booth...!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: You're the only ones who make these dolls!
Do you have any proof it was us?

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: You came to our booth before to pester us about the forum posts and the dolls.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: This whole thing started right after your visit.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Huh? How does that prove anything?

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Then by that logic, shouldn't you be suspecting every customer at the festival!

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: ... Don't change the subject.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: W-we've already disposed of all the witch dolls, so we don't have any left.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: L-liar...

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I bet you're hiding them somewhere!!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Umm... B-but we really don't have any...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: You can go ahead and find them for yourselves. ♡
The man in the jacket jerks his chin, and the male staff member steps into the booth and opens the boxes one by one.
Inside, there is nothing but leftover wrapping paper, cooking utensils, and decorations used around the booth.

lines.speaker: malestaff_01
lines.text: There aren't any witch dolls.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: ... Wh-why aren't there any?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Th-they have to be here somewhere...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: We don't have them, so...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Hmm... isn't this the doll that you bought from our booth?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: So why are you questioning us?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: It keeps coming back even when we throw it out...!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: And how is that our fault?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: W-well...!

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: ... Never mind.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: ... Boss?

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: There are none here. There's no point in looking any further.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: No, I'll stay.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I need to see for myself whether these people really aren't up to anything today.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: ... Do you really need to go that far?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I-I won't believe it until I see it for myself.

lines.speaker: jumperman
lines.text: *Sigh* Fine. Do whatever you want.
The man in the jacket and the male staff member head off.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: But we're gonna be leaving the booth unattended.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Since we don't have any customers, we're gonna close the booth for a bit and take a look around the festival. ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: If you're planning to keep an eye on us all day, you might as well come along!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: ... I'll come.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Suit yourself. ♡
We leave a note on the booth saying we'll be away for a bit, then start walking around the festival.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Old-Timer, I have a gift for you.
That came out of nowhere.
Belorta holds out a light green cookie.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I got this just for you. Try it!
And if I refuse...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: No refusing!
Belorta shoves the cookie into my mouth.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheehee! It's a wasabi-flavored cookie! ♡
... Blegh.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Mica, look behind you!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Huh?
*Click*

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I'm a witch ghost!
Belorta shines a flashlight under her chin, making a creepy face.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Eeeeeeek!!!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: I'll gobble you up, Mica!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: N-no... B-Belorta!!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Crust, look!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: Hmm?
Belorta presents Crust with a bizarre concoction of candy, sausage, and a mountain of whipped cream.

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: ... Wh-what's this?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It's a Halloween dish I invented!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Give it a taste and tell me what you think.

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: A-aaahhh...!
The female staff member spends the entire day following us around the festival.
Belorta watches her for a moment before walking over.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Hey, we're about to head home. Are you gonna follow us all the way there, too?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Well, I don't mind either way. ♡

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: *Sigh*
The female staff member gives us a weary look, then eventually returns to her booth without saying a word.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: ... Do you think things will be okay?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It'll be over soon. Just be patient for a little longer. ♡
When the female staff member returns to Mystery Box, she's greeted by an empty booth...
A note has been left on the table.
"We'll bring everything we need for tomorrow's sales, so you can head home for today."

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: ... I guess they went to restock.
The female staff member looks around the empty booth.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: *Sigh* I really should head home and get some rest.
*Bzzt*

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: ... Huh?
A message from an unknown sender arrives on her phone.
"Hi."
"I'm the witch."
"I'm at the garbage dump right now."

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: E-eeeek...!!
The female staff member frantically looks around.
But there isn't a soul in sight.
*Bzzt*
"Hi."
"I'm the witch."
"I'm at the alleyway across from the booth."

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Wh-who is this?! Who's playing this stupid prank on me?!
*Bzzt*
"Hi."
"I'm the witch."
"I'm right behind you."
There's a photo attached below the message.
In the photo, the female staff member is standing alone in front of the register, her back to the camera.
*Roll...*
The female staff member slowly turns around.
A witch doll rolls across the floor and comes to a stop.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Gaaaahhh!
The female staff member sprints out of the booth,
screaming at the top of her lungs.
*Whirr*
The female staff member runs into the organizing committee's office.
An employee sits at a desk toward the back, typing away on a laptop without even looking up.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Um, excuse me...

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Excuse me...!

lines.speaker: opsmalestaff
lines.text: Yes, what is it?
The employee's gaze is still fixed on the laptop screen.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Um... I work at the Mystery Box booth...

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I'd like to report myself!

lines.speaker: opsmalestaff
lines.text: ... What?
The female staff member hurries over to the employee and grabs their arm.

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Those posts about Little Witch Trick...

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: My coworkers and I were the ones who made it up and posted it!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I-I'll own up to everything I've done, so please just take me somewhere safe!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I-I've been cursed...!

lines.speaker: opsmalestaff
lines.text: What are you... Can you let go of me first...?

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: Please...! I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: femalestaff_01
lines.text: I really didn't know the curse would come back to me...!
Once the female staff member's statement is officially filed, the organizing committee temporarily suspends the Mystery Box booth's operations.
Although the man in the jacket and the male staff member claim that the female staff member acted alone,
their story falls apart when the account and device records she submitted match the findings of the analysis.
The investigation reveals that the three of them fabricated all the posts and comments targeting Little Witch Trick.
It also confirms that the same group was behind the posts targeting other booths at previous festivals.
As a result, the three of them are permanently banned from participating in the festival.
Now that everything has been settled, Belorta looks at us with a satisfied smile.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Hehe... the Witch Doll Trick was a total success! ♡

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: I'm just glad it all worked out.
... That was one hell of a plan.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheehee! Still, wasn't it fun?

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: But how did you manage to place the dolls at all the right spots?

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: We don't know anything, since Mica and I have been at the booth this whole time so we'd have an alibi.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Hehe, about that...
After the festival closes for the day and the area falls quiet,
Belorta and I head toward the Mystery Box booth with the small witch doll in hand.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Exia, how'd it go with that thing I asked you to do?

lines.speaker: exia_op_r
lines.text: The security cameras around the booth have been disabled.

lines.speaker: exia_op_r
lines.text: No footage from the area will be recorded until tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Perfect! ♡
Shall we begin, then?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Yep! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: As for the next doll, we scoped out the lady's schedule and route beforehand,

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: then placed the doll on the bench first thing in the morning!
... I had to wake up earlier than usual, too.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Heeheehee, but we succeeded in the end! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: The doll kept coming back every time they threw it away. Can you imagine how scared she must've been?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Since they're the one who cooked up that lie, they should be the ones to put an end to it!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: What about the photo sent to her phone?

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Exia took the photo using a camera near the booth and sent it to her. ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: She made it look like someone had taken the photo while standing right behind her!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: As for the witch doll, when Exia gave the signal...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Label, who was standing behind the booth, rolled it under the tent. ♡
Just like that, our Witch Doll Trick comes to a successful end.
A few days later...
Customers begin to flock to Little Witch Trick once again.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Welcome!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: The toys are over here!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: And the freshly made candies are over here!
Belorta watches the long line stretched out in front of the booth.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: It looks like our booth will win first place this year! ♡

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: Um...
Mica and Crust exchange glances.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Um... Belorta? I guess you haven't seen the forum post yet.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Huh? What post?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: The organizing committee posted an announcement.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Since the forum was used to manipulate the rankings, they decided it would be difficult to determine a fair ranking this year.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: So they're canceling this year's most popular booth selection...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: N-no way...!
Belorta lowers her head in disappointment.

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: S-still, ever since we cleared our name, we've been getting so many customers!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Y-yeah!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Sure, there may not be an official ranking anymore... but we're getting customers nonstop.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Our booth is definitely one of the most popular!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: ... But if we want to participate again next year, we'll have to stand in line to sign up again.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll stand in line with you...!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: ... Really?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Yeah! Let's do this together again next year!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: We'll definitely take first place next time!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: I'll join you as well!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: ... You too, Crust?

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: Hehe, I had so much fun at this festival!
Belorta looks at Mica and Crust for a moment before turning toward me.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: What about you, Old-Timer?
Huh?
Belorta walks up and looks up at me, her eyes filled with anticipation.
... Behind her, Mica and Crust are staring at me with the same expectant look.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: You'll join us next year too, right?
Um...

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: You will, right?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It'd be really reassuring to have you with us, Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: crust_h
lines.text: I'd love to do this again with you, Mr. Gourmand!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Next year will be even more fun than this year!
All three pairs of eyes turn toward me at once.
... All right.

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Wow, really?!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: You're the best, Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Then we're all doing this together again next year! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Look forward to it, everyone!

lines.speaker: belorta_h
lines.text: Little Witch Trick isn't going anywhere! ♡
Little Witch Trick: The End
